7084-8250-8347.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.

265-2073-2921--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
265-2073-2921--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Bartolomé del Presidio. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

1849-4316-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6006-6026--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6006-6026--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4687-5268-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
4687-5268-5296.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

654-851-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6791-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

364-1987-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1987-4477.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1987-4477.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1580-2301-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

851-1308-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

233-714-7688.description: When a land enters the battlefield, it becomes a Swamp due to Kormus Bell. This then causes it to become a 0/0 creature due to Urborg and M.O.D.O.K., and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-6260.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Vorinclex and Caradora.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2292-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
2292-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3175-7424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

2440-6633-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-6633-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

849-2034-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
849-2034-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Anax and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3944-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
3944-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2939-4658-5306.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
2939-4658-5306.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Defiant Bloodlord triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

2697-3976-6350.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2697-3976-6350.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Last Chance and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Glorious End and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Last Chance and Glorious End noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Last Chance without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Glorious End without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Last Chance trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

67-2781-6798.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2743-4615-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-4615-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-4615-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Quasiduplicate at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quasiduplicate spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-5426-6488.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-5426-6488.description:
Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Insult // Injury.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Insult // Injury.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Insult // Injury.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-5426-6488.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

930-1591-3781-5231.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

2120-5329.notablePrerequisites: Wanderwine Prophets does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2120-5329.description:
Declare Wanderwine Prophets as an attacker.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Merfolk token and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

307-2792-2985.notablePrerequisites:
Dokuchi Silencer and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Dokuchi Silencer or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
307-2792-2985.description:
Declare Great Whale and Dokuchi Silencer as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Dokuchi Silencer from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Dokuchi Silencer's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Dokuchi Silencer onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2146-3321-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

1640-2942-3011.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
1640-2942-3011.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to 1.5 times their life total, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.

3094-3609-3933-4772.manaNeeded: {6} each odd-numbered turn, with {4} available each even-numbered turn
3094-3609-3933-4772.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
3094-3609-3933-4772.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's Bastion's ability.
Resolve both Karn's Bastion abilities, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one time.
Repeat from step 1.

876-1602-3055-4050.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Nomad Mythmaker.
876-1602-3055-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nomad Mythmaker, adding {W}.
Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Nomad Mythmaker to the battlefield.
Pay {0} to equip Lightning Greaves to Nomad Mythmaker.
Activate Nomad Mythmaker by paying {W} and tapping it, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Nomad Mythmaker.
Repeat.

1110-2906-2931-5147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Faceless One for {0} due to Rakdos.
1110-2906-2931-5147.description:
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
